what_it_records: NTLM use that the Restrict NTLM audit policies record, i.e. traffic that blocking would stop (8001 client outgoing NTLM; 8002 incoming NTLM not needing a DC, e.g. local accounts or loopback; 8003 member server, domain account needing DC validation; 8004 DC, validation from a domain member over secure channel; 8005 DC, direct NTLM logon to the DC; 8006 DC, validation from a trusted domain). Needs the three Restrict NTLM audit policies; once blocking is enforced 4001-4006 are logged instead. Windows 11 24H2 / Server 2025 add richer events 4020/4022/4030/4032 (use) and 4021/4023/4031/4033 (blocked)
where_collected: Applications and Services Logs > Microsoft > Windows > NTLM > Operational
